critique.evidence: No visible motion was measured in standard mode at any viewport: 0 active animations, 0 transition elements, and 0 changed elements across 12 sampled frames. Frame pacing was stable on tablet/mobile (~16.67 ms overall, 0 long frames), but desktop averaged 20.73 ms overall with a 33.4 ms worst frame. Reduced motion matched and produced no visual changes, yet still reported 1 active animation and 89 transition-bearing elements; desktop reduced mode reached 50 ms. Smoothness and choreography therefore are not demonstrated.
critique.fix: Provide measured standard-mode frames covering an actual entrance, state change, or interaction long enough to prove choreography and stable pacing across all viewports. Under prefers-reduced-motion, eliminate the remaining active animation and transition declarations, then show zero changed elements with consistently low frame times.
